items.title: Bob Kinkel interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, October 31, 2012
items.q: There’s a management office, Night Castle Management, there’s a tour manager, Elliot Saltzman... So it’s a huge collaborative effort to put up a show like that.

ctx.x: Do you have someone who doesn’t perform to keep all this together? Like do you have an office?

There’s a management office, Night Castle Management, there’s a tour manager, Elliot Saltzman, there’s a lighting designer, Brian Hartley, there’s all these people — Dave Whitman mixes the front of the house, the live sound, he’s also the engineer on all the records, so live sounds like the record. And for the other coast he’s trained the guy to do the mixing. So it’s a huge collaborative effort to put up a show like that. And I toured from ’99 through, when was my last tour, through 2009, so eleven years of…
